The greatest common divisor of $2^{1998} - 1$ and $2^{1989} - 1$ is $2^{\gcd(1998, 1989)} - 1$. Calculating $\gcd(1998, 1989)$ using the Euclidean algorithm:  
$$
\gcd(1998, 1989) = \gcd(1989, 1998 \mod 1989) = \gcd(1989, 9) = \gcd(9, 1989 \mod 9) = \gcd(9, 0) = 9.
$$  
Thus, the result is $2^9 - 1 = 511$.
